Title: Application Insights auto-instrumentation for .NET6 App Services

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor application insights is announcing day zero support for .NET 6.0 auto-instrumentation on Azure App Services for both Windows and Linux.

Both framework-dependent and self-contained apps are supported.

Learn more.
